name: diagrams
description: Author UML diagrams (sequence, FSM, deployment, ...) as HTML/CSS with full manual layout — no auto-placement or routing — and render to PNG via headless Chromium. Use when the user wants precise control over element positions or dislikes PlantUML/Mermaid auto-layout.

scale.title: Render scale
scale.description: deviceScaleFactor for PNG export; 2 or 3 give crisp output. Passed to the renderer as DG_SCALE.
